serverInfo.name: jaydb-mcp
serverInfo.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for JayDB & JayDB Cloud — allows AI assistants to read, write, and manage serverless documents with optimistic concurrency (CAS)

tools.name: jaydb_get
tools.description: Retrieve a document by key from JayDB or JayDB Cloud

key.description: The document path key, e.g. 'users/123/profile' or 'boards/task-4'

tools.name: jaydb_put
tools.description: Create or update a document with optimistic concurrency control (CAS)

data.description: The document content (JSON object, array, or string)

ifMatch.description: Expected ETag for optimistic locking (CAS). Rejects write if modified concurrently.

createOnly.description: If true, fails if document already exists (If-None-Match: *)

tools.name: jaydb_delete
tools.description: Delete a document from JayDB or JayDB Cloud

key.description: The document path key to delete

ifMatch.description: Expected ETag for optimistic locking guard

tools.name: jaydb_list
tools.description: List keys and metadata by prefix in JayDB or JayDB Cloud

prefix.description: Key prefix to list, e.g. 'users/' or 'boards/'

tools.name: jaydb_health
tools.description: Check connectivity and health of the JayDB endpoint

baseUrl.description: JayDB base URL to test (defaults to configured JAYDB_URL)
